issues.description: The problem text explicitly instructs students to implement the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) as public, but the UML earlier in the problem shows it as private and both the template and solution implement it as private. This visibility contradiction (problem statement vs UML/template/solution) can confuse students and may cause tests that expect a public method to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the visibility mismatch by choosing one consistent visibility. Preferably update the template and solution to declare singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) as public (and adjust its signature accordingly) to match the explicit textual instruction in the problem, or revise the problem text to state the method should be private to match the UML and current code.
